title: EASY TICKER
subtitle: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO. TIMED. OFFICE SCALE. KEEP THE PACE HONEST.

script.welcome: ON YOUR FEET. SATURDAY. EASY TICKER. FIFTEEN MINUTES. EASY CARDIO. TIMED. NO HIDING BEHIND THE WEEKEND, YOU LAZY SOD.
script.start: CLOCK IS LIVE. MOVE YOUR ARSE.
script.rest: REST. BREATHE. DO NOT COLLAPSE INTO THE FURNITURE.
script.lastSet: LAST ROUND. FINISH CLEAN. I'M WATCHING.
script.complete: DISMISSED. EASY TICKER DONE. HEART HONEST. LEGS QUIET. ENJOY THE WEEKEND, YOU EARNED A BIT OF IT.
script.pause: HOLD. CLOCK STOPPED. DO NOT GET COMFY.

exercises.name: GLUTE BRIDGE
exercises.cue: ON YOUR BACK. FEET FLAT. SQUEEZE THE GLUTES AND LIFT SLOW. HOLD A BEAT AT THE TOP. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH AND HIP OPENER. NO RUSHING.
exercises.speakStart: GLUTE BRIDGES. TWO SETS OF EIGHT. SLOW UP. SQUEEZE. HOLD A BEAT. THIS IS YOUR STRETCH WORK. OPEN THE HIPS AFTER THAT DESK. DO NOT BOUNCE LIKE A LAZY TRAMPOLINE.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY FIVE. KEEP THE HIPS LOOSE.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGE
exercises.cue: LONG STEP BACK. FRONT KNEE TRACKS THE TOE. LIGHT HAND ON A CHAIR FOR BALANCE. OWN THE WOBBLE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. TWO SETS. FIVE EACH LEG. CONTROL THE DROP. CHAIR FOR BALANCE. THIS IS YOUR BALANCE WORK. DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK ON PARADE.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS
exercises.cue: FIFTH STAIR IF IT IS STURDY, OR A LOW SOLID STEP. EASY CADENCE. FULL FOOT. STAND TALL AT THE TOP. THIS IS TIMED CARDIO, NOT A SPRINT.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. TWO ROUNDS. FORTY SECONDS. EASY CADENCE. FULL FOOT ON THE STEP. STAND TALL. THIS IS YOUR CARDIO TICKER. DO NOT RACE LIKE A HEADLESS CHICKEN.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. SHAKE THE LEGS. KEEP BREATHING.

exercises.name: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE FLOOR OR A LOW STEP. HIPS LOW. STEADY DRIVE. EASY CARDIO PACE. DO NOT RUSH FORM.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. TWO ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. HIPS LOW. STEADY. EASY CARDIO. EMPTY A BIT OF THE TANK WITHOUT LOOKING LIKE A PANICKED GOAT. MOVE.
exercises.speakRest: THIRTY. BREATHE. NEXT ONE COMES FAST.

exercises.name: WALKING LUNGE
exercises.cue: SHORT PATH IN THE ROOM OR HALL. STEP, DROP, STAND. HAND ON A WALL IF YOU NEED IT. EASY PACE. OWN EACH STEP.
exercises.speakStart: WALKING LUNGES. TWO SETS. SIX EACH LEG. EASY PACE. STEP, DROP, STAND. WALL IF YOU NEED IT. THIS IS YOUR CARDIO LEGS. DO NOT SHUFFLE LIKE YOU ARE LATE FOR TEA.

exercises.name: SIDE PLANK
exercises.cue: HIPS HIGH. DROP THE BOTTOM KNEE. FIVE SECONDS ONLY. BUILD TOWARD TWENTY LATER. NO SAG.
exercises.speakStart: SIDE PLANK. TWO HOLDS. FIVE SECONDS EACH SIDE. KNEE DOWN IS LEGAL. HIPS UP. SHORT AND HONEST. WE ARE BUILDING TOWARD TWENTY. NO SAGGING.
exercises.speakDone: SIDE PLANKS DONE. THAT IS THE LOT.
